title: Trinity Camera As Session-Only View Action
description: Convert the trinity plugin's nodeGraphViewport action from ActionKind::Operation (VCS-tracked document edits) to ActionKind::View (session-only, non-undoable, non-replicated) across its three related crates: the jack app (semio-s-app-trinity-jack-ui), the rewrite app (semio-s-app-trinity-rewrite-ui), and the shared graph-model crate trinity_ram. Prerequisite/sibling piece of work for the separate universal command-logging mechanism in semio-framework-plugin (not touching that mechanism itself). Per app: change nodeGraphViewport's builder registration from .operation(...) to .view_action(...); move the camera value out of the VCS-tracked document and into the app's own ephemeral runtime struct; rewrite the handler to write the runtime field directly and return an empty-operations ActionEmit; update render call sites to read camera from the new runtime location. In trinity_ram: delete TrinityGraphOperation::SetCamera and TrinityGraphDiff.camera entirely (apply/absorb/diff/backwards/DSL arms) - but KEEP GraphFixture.camera (and its DSL block) as a seed-only field, read once when a fixture is first loaded to initialize runtime camera, never written back to by any operation. Hand-fix the existing jack/ram tests that assert the old VCS-camera-undo behavior to assert the new runtime-based behavior instead. Verify with cargo check --all-targets and cargo test --lib for each touched package (trinity_ram, semio-s-app-trinity-jack-ui, semio-s-app-trinity-rewrite-ui). This trinity scope is NOT covered by the existing sibling ticket 26/07/31/CAMERA-AS-SESSION-ONLY-VIEW-ACTION-ACROSS-PLUGINS (which lists cad/fem/shooting/writer/sequence/mathematical/lowpoly only, no trinity).
summary: Converted trinity's nodeGraphViewport action from ActionKind::Operation to ActionKind::View across the jack app, rewrite app, and the shared trinity_ram crate. jack: added TrinityJackRuntime.camera (seeded from the initial/preset fixture's seed-only camera field), nodeGraphViewport now writes it directly and returns ActionEmit::default() (no operations); render_graph reads viewport from runtime.camera instead of fixture.camera. rewrite: added RewritePlayRuntime.before_pane_camera (seeded via new seed_before_pane_camera() helper, on Default::default() and on resetRule), nodeGraphViewport for the Before surface now writes it directly with no operations (replacing the old whole-RewriteRuleState SetState-per-pan-tick amend); render_rule_graph/render_fixture_graph gained a camera_override: Option<&Camera> parameter, composed only for the Before pane's render call. Both apps' builders moved nodeGraphViewport from .operation(...) to .view_action(...). trinity_ram: deleted TrinityGraphOperation::SetCamera and TrinityGraphDiff.camera entirely (apply/absorb/diff/backwards/DSL-mirror-enum/to-dsl/from-dsl arms) but kept GraphFixture.camera (and its GraphFixtureDsl camera block) as a seed-only field per the documented exception, with a one-line seed-only doc comment added. No fixture/example .trinity files needed hand-fixing since the DSL-level camera field and its block syntax were untouched. Rewrote 3 tests: trinity_ram's op_text_round_trip_set_camera (deleted, no operation to round-trip), graph_op_set_camera_and_set_fixture_undo (renamed to graph_op_set_fixture_undo, camera-undo assertions dropped, SetFixture-undo assertions kept), trinity_graph_diff_absorb_merges_fields (camera fields dropped from both diffs, kept recompute_derived/nodes.added assertions); jack's node_graph_viewport_emits_coalesced_set_camera (renamed to node_graph_viewport_writes_runtime_camera_without_operations, now asserts zero operations + unchanged seed camera on the document + the rendered scene reflecting the live runtime camera). Added one new test in the rewrite app (node_graph_viewport_writes_before_pane_runtime_camera_without_operations) asserting the same runtime-only contract for the Before pane, since no prior test covered it. Verified: cargo check --all-targets and cargo test --lib pass clean for all three packages - trinity_ram (56/56), semio-s-app-trinity-jack-ui (22/22), semio-s-app-trinity-rewrite-ui (14/14). The rewrite_engine crate's own setCamera WASM binding (a separate canvas host API operating directly on its own in-memory Graph, never a VCS document operation) was left untouched as out of scope.
